title: Introduce regional soft-failover stabilizer and tenant-sticky eviction metadata fix
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Fix: Prevent tenant eviction records from being overwritten during regional failover; add soft-failover stabilizer to reduce oscillation during transient health probes.
description: Context: During a recent incident, we observed repeated tenant eviction and re-join churn when a regional health probe flapped, causing sticky eviction state to be inconsistently applied across replicas. This caused SLO breaches for a small cohort of high-throughput tenants and increased request tail latencies. Motivation: Implement a lightweight stabilizer to avoid immediate hard-evictions and ensure tenant eviction metadata is preserved during cross-region handoffs. This change reduces the window where tenants oscillate between active/evicted states and prevents metadata races that can cause permanent tenant isolation. What changed: 1) Introduced a soft-failover stabilizer component in the regional failover orchestrator that observes probe jitter and applies a 3-stage holdoff (observe -> soft-evict -> hard-evict) with exponential backoff; 2) Fixed a race in tenant eviction metadata replication where ephemeral sticky-evict flags could be overwritten by late-arriving region-heartbeats; eviction records are now versioned and merged deterministically; 3) Added metrics and tracing hooks (region.failover.stabilizer.*, tenant.eviction.merge.*) for post-rollout analysis; 4) Conservative defaults applied: default stabilization window 12s, backoff cap 2m; policy can be tuned via operators in the console. Testing & validation: Unit tests for the merge logic, deterministic simulation harness runs with synthetic jitter (10k traces), e2e canary in us-west with 1% of regional traffic for 24h. Rollout plan: Start as a feature-flagged rollout to canary -> gradual ramp to 25% regional routing -> 100% after monitoring and SRE signoff. Rollback: feature flag toggle and a one-line revert in the orchestrator config; safe to toggle without rolling restarts. Related: ENG-8472 (stabilizer design), SUP-3319 (incident postmortem).

review_conversation: Diego: Asked for clarification on backoff bounds and whether the stabilizer introduces extra latency to normal failovers. Response: Stabilizer only delays hard-evict by default and exposes a policy; normal health-failures that meet the hard criteria still proceed. Ruth: Requested additional unit tests for merge conflict where two regions report different sticky-evict versions. Response: Added merge unit tests and simulation coverage; included deterministic seed for reproducibility. Omar: Concern about metrics cardinality — requested tag consolidation. Response: Collapsed tenant_id tag to tenant_cohort in high-cardinality metrics and left tenant_id only on trace spans. Diego: Approved after minor nits. Ruth: Approved. Omar: Approved. Final author note: squashed commits to keep history small and documented the feature flag in docs.
